metricDesc.matches: Matches with minutes on the pitch.
metricDesc.minutes: Minutes played according to the report line-up.
metricDesc.balls: Times he is involved with the ball (touches, passes, controls).
metricDesc.possession: Minutes with the ball at his feet.
metricDesc.useful: Actions that move play forward or keep it with an advantage (Panini criterion).
metricDesc.losses: Balls lost that end in opponent possession. Lower is better.
metricDesc.passes_given: Passes to team-mates recorded in the passing matrix.
metricDesc.pass_acc: % of completed passes over attempted (passing matrix).
metricDesc.long_ok: Long passes that reach a team-mate with an advantage.
metricDesc.key_passes: Passes that put a team-mate in a shooting position.
metricDesc.assists: Key passes that end in a goal.
metricDesc.recoveries: Balls won back that end in own possession.
metricDesc.rec_attack: Balls won back in the attacking third.
metricDesc.rec_box: Balls won back in own penalty area.
metricDesc.rec_air: Balls won back in the air.
metricDesc.anticipations: Balls won by getting ahead of the opponent.
metricDesc.dribbles: Dribbles that beat the opponent and keep the ball.
metricDesc.crosses: Open-play crosses that find a team-mate.
metricDesc.box_balls: Balls played inside the opponent box.
metricDesc.layoffs: First-time lay-offs with back to goal that reach a team-mate.
metricDesc.conceded: Goals conceded with him on the pitch. Lower is better.
metricDesc.high_claims: Balls caught or punched in the air.
metricDesc.long_kicks: Long kicks that reach a team-mate.
